|/datatype/datatype_implicit_conversion/heap/test_sdv_compare_implicit_conversion_bit|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e50a1ad9a3311dc96b5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1pJh3Fn4XIGwNdlX2S5_uEEf8JH9Fpj76B1ubjZJ8lI),drop table if exists tb_bit_01;    
  create table tb_bit_01(id int,c1 bit(64));    
  insert into tb_bit_01 values(4,'');    
  insert into tb_bit_01 values(5,1);    
  insert into tb_bit_01 values(6,null);    
  insert into tb_bit_01 values(7,0);    
  commit;    
  drop table if exists tb_bit_02;    
  create table tb_bit_02(c1 tinyint);    
  insert into tb_bit_02 values (-128),(0),(1),(null),(null),(null);    
  commit;,select     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,t2.c1 from tb_bit_01 t1,tb_bit_02 t2 where t1.c1=t2.c1 ;|bit类型是有变化的，空串在mysql上是可以直接插入到bit列 并且查出来为0的 这个用例是正常的|
|/datatype/datatype_implicit_conversion/heap/test_sdv_compare_implicit_conversion_time|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e508970c2af4f521843/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1pJh3Fn4XIGwNdlX2S5_uEEf8JH9Fpj76B1ubjZJ8lI),这个的用例是：    
  drop table if exists tb_time_01;    
  create table tb_time_01(id int, c1 time);    
  insert into tb_time_01 values(1,'10:10:10.101010');    
  insert into tb_time_01 values(4,'22:10:59.000000');    
  insert into tb_time_01 values(5,'01:01:01');    
  insert into tb_time_01 values(6, null);    
  insert into tb_time_01 values(7,'');    
  commit;,drop table if exists tb_time_02;    
  create table tb_time_02(c16 time);    
  insert into tb_time_02 values('10:10:10.101010');    
  insert into tb_time_02 values(null);    
  insert into tb_time_02 values('22:10:59.000000');    
  insert into tb_time_02 values('01:01:01');    
  insert into tb_time_02 values('');    
  commit;,select     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,t2.c16 from tb_time_01 t1,tb_time_02 t2 where t1.c1=t2.c16 ;|time类型插入空串，在主干分支上是null的，需求和mysql分支都是全0。结果合理。

|/datatype/datatype_implicit_conversion/heap/test_sdv_compare_implicit_conversion_varchar|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e50a1ad9a3311dc96b6/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1pJh3Fn4XIGwNdlX2S5_uEEf8JH9Fpj76B1ubjZJ8lI),这个的用例是：    
  alter session set date_format='YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS';    
  drop table if exists tb_string_01;    
  create table tb_string_01(id int,c1 varchar(100),c2 char(50));    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(1,'FALSE','TRUE');    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(2,'true','false');    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(3,'False','TRue');    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(4,'ON','OFF');    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(5,'NO','yes');    
  insert into tb_string_01 values(8,'','');    
  commit;,drop table if exists tb_string_02;    
  create table tb_string_02(c9 varchar(50));    
  insert into tb_string_02 values ('FALSE');    
  insert into tb_string_02 values ('OFF');    
  insert into tb_string_02 values ('');    
  commit;,select     [t1.id](http://t1.id)    ,t1.c1,t2.c9 from tb_string_01 t1,tb_string_02 t2 where t1.c1=t2.c9 ;|构建结果空串等于空串为true，旧代码null=null为false。,结果合理|
|/datatype/nchar_nvarchar_nclob/DBMS_LOB_COMPARE/test_sdv_DBMS_LOB_COMPAR_01|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e508970c2af4f521845/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1pJh3Fn4XIGwNdlX2S5_uEEf8JH9Fpj76B1ubjZJ8lI),这个用例是：

  commit;,select DBMS_LOB.COMPARE(c1,coalesce('','','aaaa')) from test_YDBRD8352_01;|coalesce('','','aaaa') 原来返回aaaa现在返回空串。,结果合理|
